description:
Several tests assert less than their names state, or exercise a local re-implementation instead of production code.

## Background

Reported locations: `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/awgn_link.rs:575` (asserts a locally recomputed formula); `crates/gf2-coding/src/gldpc/mod.rs:1511` (asserts only dimensions); `crates/gf2-coding/src/grand/sogrand.rs:1135` (early return skips the ratio assertion); `crates/gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs` kani proofs `mask_tail_zeros_padding`, `mask_tail_preserves_valid_bits`, `ones_constructor_tail_clean` (re-implement the mask) and `test_parity_xor_property`; `crates/gf2-core/src/alg/rref.rs` `test_rref_pivot_from_right`; `crates/gf2-core/src/field/charpoly.rs:2423` `test_kg_singular_matrix` (vacuous branch); `crates/gf2-kernels-hip` `launch_chacha20_awgn.rs` `test_host_rng_reproducible_at_seed` (compares an RNG with itself, while `Cargo.toml` states a `rand_chacha` comparison). `@/inv/semantic-test-assertions` applies.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each listed test asserts the property its name states against production code, or is removed.
- [hard] REQ-02: The `gf2-kernels-hip` `Cargo.toml` comment matches the tests that exist.
title: Strengthen vacuous and weak tests reported by the comment sweep
